title: Promote Internally or Hire Externally? The Role of Gift Exchange and Performance Measurement Precision

scopes.description: The full supplied author workflow includes the main Stata analysis do-file, a named Table 2 Panel B long-format ANOVA companion supplied in a commented note, and manual Excel construction for Figures 2 and 3. The main do-file assumes its own experiment dataset is already loaded in Stata memory, and the package does not include that dataset or an active main-data loader/preparation driver. The companion names a separate long-format .dta input and is retained in scope despite its comment status; its use, clear command requires an isolated Stata data state so later main-data analyses are not displaced. The Excel workbook, chart recipe, and mapping between two active Figure 3 result blocks and the plotted figure remain unresolved.

requirements.description: An author-prepared Stata dataset loaded in memory before the supplied analysis do-file runs. The active script assumes a variable-column analysis dataset with fields such as Choice, subjectnr, Precise, promote, effort measures, pay measures, and demographic/scale variables; it does not define how those fields are loaded or constructed. The exact file, format, field profile, and preparation chain are not specified.

issues.description: The active analysis file assumes a Stata dataset is already loaded in memory; it contains no active file-loading or variable-construction stage. The datasheet gives a generic raw-data placement instruction but no input filename, format, schema, or reproducible producer. The required current input is therefore unresolved even though its historical collection source and non-proprietary designation are documented.

The Stata file supplies summary outputs for Figure 2 and two distinct active Figure 3 result blocks, then labels Figure 2 and the later Figure 3 margins as done in Excel. The earlier Figure 3 block uses a logit with EarlyEffortT and requests dydx(Precise) at values 5 through 100 within Choice==1; the later block uses EarlyEffort and requests margins by Precise at values 0 through 20 without that Choice filter. This release supplies no workbook or chart recipe mapping either result block to plotted series, axes, or labels. Both authored blocks are retained without selecting or changing one. The missing handoff prevents confirming reproduction of those figure stages but does not create a separate raw-data requirement.

The supplied source note names CLM EmpDataLongFormatTypes.dta for a long-format Table 2 Panel B companion and its three ANOVA specifications consume effort, cond, id, period, tot_comp, and tot_ind for period < 4. The file, field definitions/coverage, and author-supported producer or mapping from the main in-memory dataset are not supplied. The branch is a comment in the main .do, so it requires working-copy activation after the input is established. Its use, clear statement replaces Stata memory; run it in a separate companion driver/session to preserve the main dataset. No access barrier is established.
